items.title: Open a cold call in 20 seconds
items.prompt: You're calling a small business owner you've never spoken to about your service. Open the call.

items.title: Tell a road trip story
items.prompt: Tell a story from a road trip: the best moment, the worst moment, or the weirdest gas station.

items.title: Apologize for missing a friend's dinner
items.prompt: Your friend says: “You missed my birthday dinner. Everyone kept asking where you were.” Respond.

items.title: The teacher or mentor who changed you
items.prompt: Tell a story about a teacher, coach or mentor who changed how you think.

items.title: Give a halftime pep talk to a kids' team
items.prompt: You're coaching your kid's soccer team, and they're down two goals at halftime. Give them a pep talk.

items.title: Get your landlord to fix the heat this week
items.prompt: Your heating stopped working and it's freezing. Call your landlord and get it fixed this week.

items.title: Your week in three sentences
items.prompt: Someone asks how your week has been. Sum it up in three sentences, with one highlight.
